description: VN 'làm bài tập' transfer: 'làm' = make/do, so learners say 'make homework'. English collocates 'do homework'. Rule en-vietlish-collocation-do-homework rewrites make->do (mirrors take-photo/make-mistake) ONLY when 'homework' is the bare direct-object head noun followed by the shared COLLOCATION_OBJECT_TAIL boundary. Scoped to the single noun 'homework' (exercises/work excluded — they carry a valid 'make = create' sense).
fp_risk_note: Low risk. 'make' is correct in the CAUSATIVE 'make homework fun/difficult' (object + adjective complement) and with every non-homework object. V1 fires only on 'make homework' at a collocation boundary; the tail lookahead locks out the causative and any other continuation, and 'do homework' is already correct so it abstains.

positive.notes: make + homework + frequency tail -> do homework.
Past 'made' + possessive 'her homework' at sentence end -> did homework.

negative.notes: Causative 'make homework fun' (object + adjective). 'fun' is not a collocation boundary -> must abstain. (Precision lock.)

negative.input: She makes homework difficult for us.
negative.expectedCorrection: She makes homework difficult for us.
negative.notes: Causative again ('make X difficult') -> must abstain. (Precision lock.)
Already the correct collocation 'do homework' -> must abstain.
Non-homework object; 'make a cake' is correct -> must not fire.
'make a decision' is a correct make-collocation -> must not fire.
